description:
Change the draft with a list of `ops`: add, update, move or delete nodes, and connect or disconnect them. The ops apply all together or not at all. You must send the `revision` from your last read. If you get `409 revision_conflict`, read the workflow again and retry. Secrets read back as `********`. Send them back unchanged to keep the stored value. This edits the draft only. Use `publishWorkflow` to make it live.

(Tags: Workflows)

items.description:
One edit to the draft. Set `op` and the fields that op uses.

| `op` | Fields | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `add_node` | `id`, `type`, `label?`, `config?`, `after?`, `handle?`, `position?` | Adds a node. With `after`, it also connects it to that node (on output `handle`). |
| `update_node` | `id`, `config?`, `label?` | Merges `config` keys into the node. A `null` value removes a key. |
| `move_node` | `id`, `position` | Moves a node on the canvas. |
| `delete_node` | `id` | Deletes a node and its edges. |
| `connect` | `from`, `to`, `handle?` | Adds an edge. |
| `disconnect` | `from`, `to`, `handle?` | Removes an edge. |

after.description: `add_node`: id of the node to connect the new node to.

config.description:
`add_node`, `update_node`: the node's settings. The fields come from
`getWorkflowNodeType`. Send a secret back as `********` to keep the
stored value.

from.description: `connect`, `disconnect`: id of the node the edge starts at.

handle.description: `add_node`, `connect`, `disconnect`: the output of the source node. Omit for the default output.

id.description: Node id. For `add_node`, lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. It must be new.

label.description: `add_node`, `update_node`: the name shown on the canvas.

position.description: `add_node`, `move_node`: canvas position. `add_node` places the node for you if you omit it.

to.description: `connect`, `disconnect`: id of the node the edge ends at.

revision.description: The `draft.revision` from your last `getWorkflow` or edit.

name: editWorkflow
